name: AetherMap - Master Tabletop Projection System
description: Dual-window TTRPG projection system for DMs and players playing offline with a digital projector or TV tabletop. Features full Campaign Tracker (time calendar, quests, visited atlas, interactive NPC relationship web, session lazy prep, party treasury), Miro-like master canvas, universal data parser, Polza.ai AI neural art generation (portraits, monsters, spells, items, locations, maps), system-specific rules engine, fog of war, video maps, and elemental effects.
